content: {"reasoning":"The claim has an invalid diagnosis pairing and lacks required prior authorization; this payer offers no retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer review. Correcting claim data alone would not resolve the authorization barrier, and an appeal is premature without a denial. Escalation is needed to determine a compliant path and any collectible patient responsibility, rather than submitting a known-defective claim or billing the patient the full balance.","action":"escalate"}
